triggers.name: new_csv_file
triggers.title: New/updated CSV file in directory
triggers.description: New/updated CSV file in directory on SFTP secondary server
triggers.help: Triggers when a CSV file is added or updated in a specified directory. This trigger will batch CSV lines according to the user-specified batch size. Each batch will be processed as a job. The max batch size is 1000.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: directory
input.label: Directory
input.hint: Files in this directory will be processed, ordered by ascending modification time.

input.name: separator
input.label: Column delimiter
input.hint: The character used to separate column values within each CSV row.

input.name: skip_header_line
input.label: Contains header row?
input.hint: Set to Yes if the first CSV row is a header row, containing column names.

input.name: max_batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Number of CSV rows per batch. Instead of reading rows one by one, Workato reads a batch of CSV rows at a time to increase throughput. Learn more

input.name: expected_encoding
input.label: Expected encoding
input.hint: Default encoding type is set to UTF-8, and typically doesn't need to be changed.

input.name: ignore_missing_files
input.label: Ignore missing files?
input.hint: Set to Yes to ignore or skip files that are not available currently. This is useful if your recipe involves moving files to a different location after they are processed.

input.name: column_value_by
input.label: Keep track of columns by
input.hint: Configure this if your expected CSV file will not have fixed column order or column names: - If Column order is set: Your CSV file must have fixed column order for recipe to work. Column names don't n…

input.name: quote_char
input.label: Quote character
input.hint: Character used to quote the CSV cell values. Select None if no quote character is used.

triggers.name: new_file_in_dir
triggers.title: New/updated file in directory
triggers.description: New/updated file in directory on SFTP secondary server
triggers.help: Triggers when a file is created or updated in specified directory. Watches first-level directory only. Use the Download file action to fetch contents of file.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: directory
input.label: Directory
input.hint: Files in this directory will be processed, ordered by ascending modification time.

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Get file created/updated since the given date/time.Leave empty to get files created/updated 1 hour ago. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more

actions.name: dir
actions.title: List folder
actions.description: List folder in SFTP secondary server
actions.help: Use this action to list contents of a folder/directory in SFTP server.

input.name: directory
input.label: Folder path
input.hint: Provide the full path of the folder in the SFTP server to list the contents. Example: /folder1/folder2

actions.name: mkdir
actions.title: Create folder
actions.description: Create folder in SFTP secondary server
actions.help: This action allows you to create a folder in the SFTP server. This action will fail if a folder already exists in the given path.

input.name: folder_name
input.label: Folder path
input.hint: Provide the complete path of the folder to be created. Example: /folder1/folder2/new_folder_name

actions.name: remove
actions.title: Delete file
actions.description: Delete file in SFTP secondary server
actions.help: Deletes a file from your SFTP server. This action will fail if the specified file is not found.

input.name: filename
input.label: File path
input.hint: Provide the complete path of the file to be deleted. Example: /folder1/filename.csv

actions.name: remove_folder
actions.title: Delete folder
actions.description: Delete folder in SFTP secondary server
actions.help: This action allows you to delete an entire folder from SFTP server. It will fail if the folder is not found in the specified path provided or if the folder is not empty.

input.name: foldername
input.label: Folder path
input.hint: Provide the full path of the folder to delete. Example: /folder1/folder2

actions.name: rename
actions.title: Rename/move file
actions.description: Rename/move file in SFTP secondary server
actions.help: Use this action to rename a file or move a file to a new destination in SFTP server.

input.name: from
input.label: Source path
input.hint: Provide the full path of the file including the file name. Example: /folder1/folder2/filename.csv

input.name: to
input.label: Destination path
input.hint: Provide the new full path of the file including the file name. To rename a file provide the same path as above with a new file name. To move a file, make sure the folders in the new path exists. Examp…

actions.name: search_files_folders
actions.title: Search files/folders
actions.description: Search files or folders in SFTP secondary server
actions.help: Search for files, folders or both within a given folder path in your SFTP server. This action will fail if the provided path is not found.

input.name: foldername
input.label: Parent folder path
input.hint: Provide the path of the parent folder. All files/folders under this folder will be searched. Search does not include contents of the subfolders. Example: /folder1/folder2

input.name: type
input.label: Entity
input.hint: Select whether to search for files, folders or both.

input.name: search
input.label: Search term
input.hint: Enter the search term. Supports filename globbing based search terms. For example, to search for all csv files in the folder, use *.csv . Learn more about using filename glob expressions.

actions.name: set_permissions
actions.title: Change permission of a file or a folder
actions.description: Change permission of a file or a folder in SFTP secondary Server
actions.help: This action changes permission to a particular file or folder in SFTP Server. This replaces any existing permission with the specified values.

input.name: file_path
input.label: File path
input.hint: Provide the full path of the file including the file name. Example: /folder1/folder2/filename.csv

input.name: apply_permissions_method
input.label: Apply permissions method
input.hint: Choose a method to apply file permission

input.name: permission_owner
input.label: Permission for owner
input.hint: Select permissions for file owner

input.name: permission_group
input.label: Permission for group
input.hint: Select permissions for group members

input.name: permission_others
input.label: Permission for others
input.hint: Select permissions for all other users

input.name: permission_code
input.label: Permission code
input.hint: Enter 3-digit code

actions.name: stat
actions.title: Get file information
actions.description: Get file information from SFTP secondary server
actions.help: This action allows you to get basic information about a file in the SFTP server such as size, created and modified timestamp, etc.

input.name: filename
input.label: File path
input.hint: Provide the full path of the file including the file name. Example: /folder1/folder2/filename.csv

actions.name: streamable_download
actions.title: Download file
actions.description: Download file from SFTP secondary server
actions.help: Download file contents from SFTP server. File will be downloaded in binary mode.

input.name: filename
input.label: File path
input.hint: Provide the full path of the file including the file name. Example: /folder1/folder2/filename.csv

input.name: expected_encoding
input.label: Encoding
input.hint: Choose the encoding to set it explicitly.

input.name: download_in_one_go
input.label: Download file in one go
input.hint: Allows the file to be fetched completely in one go if your SFTP server does not support multipart downloads. Maximum size supported is 310 MB. For larger file downloads do not select this option. Defa…

actions.name: upload
actions.title: Upload file
actions.description: Upload file to SFTP secondary server
actions.help: Upload a file to a specific path in your SFTP server. If the file already exists, this action will append or overwrite the file, depending on the option provided. Otherwise, it will create a new file.

input.name: filename
input.label: File path
input.hint: Provide the full path of the file including the file name. The folders provided in the path must exist before adding a file in it. Example: /folder1/folder2/filename.csv

input.name: content
input.label: File contents
input.hint: Add file contents here. Empty file contents are allowed.

input.name: append
input.label: Append
input.hint: Select Yes to append the contents to an already existing file.If option No is selected, the existing file will be overwritten.

input.name: expected_size
input.label: Expected size
input.hint: Expected size of existing file in bytes when appending. Helps ensure integrity of multiple-step uploads
